description: Compress, optimize, resize or convert many image files on this computer in one call, from a folder or a list of paths. By default images are scaled to 70% at quality 70, keep their format, and are written to a "compressed" folder next to them. For a website, format "webp" with maxWidth (like 1600) usually works best: big images shrink to fit, small ones keep their size. Files that would not get smaller are copied as they are. No need to list, measure or check the files first: pass the folder as inputDir. Originals and existing files are never replaced unless overwrite is set. The result gives the total size before and after, and any image that failed.

details.description: List every image with its new size and dimensions, not only the ones that failed

format.description: Output format for every image. Defaults to each image's own format, GIF becomes PNG

height.description: Exact output height in px. Alone, keeps the aspect ratio

inputDir.description: Absolute path of a folder. Its JPG, PNG, WebP and GIF files are compressed. Use this or inputPaths

inputPaths.description: Absolute paths of the images. Use this or inputDir

keepExif.description: Keep camera, GPS and date metadata

maxHeight.description: Shrink to fit this height in px, never enlarge

maxWidth.description: Shrink to fit this width in px, never enlarge. Best for web, e.g. 1600. Without scale, smaller images keep their size

outputDir.description: Absolute path of the folder to write results to, under the same file names. Created if missing. Defaults to a "compressed" folder next to each image

overwrite.description: Replace output files that already exist

recursive.description: Also compress images in subfolders of inputDir (skipping node_modules and dot folders), keeping the folder structure in outputDir

scale.description: Size in percent of the original (or crop), like the SIZE slider in the PressIt app. Use instead of width/height. Defaults to 70 when width and height are not given; pass 100 to keep the original size

width.description: Exact output width in px. Alone, keeps the aspect ratio

name: compress_images
title: Compress images
